description: This file holds the closure policy of the Reified RSpaces realignment leaves (realignment closure design, sections 4 to 6). The checker scripts/verify-reified/check-closure.py reads it. Each entry of leaves binds a pgmcp leaf to its model items, headlines, entry points, document headings, references and anchors. The key optional_model_items lists the model items that the model map marks with required false. The key audits gives the result of each audit script in the hermetic harness, as measured on the host. The key ledger_copy describes the redacted copy of the design ledger and the README strings that record its provenance.

doc_references.text: ![Checkpoint, replay and sweep as a sequence. Play on the proposer: the reducer starts the evaluation scope, the space agent opens a transaction through the handle, reads the staged view, stages operations and commits; the commit makes the observer calls and logs the events under sub_order(parent, i) and writes the hot store. At the end of the deploy the reducer sweeps the volatile channels, which removes their data, continuations and joins with no event. The checkpoint turns the hot store changes into history actions; the deletes of the swept keys are absent from the trie and change nothing, so the root covers the durable state only. Replay on the validator: rig binds each recorded COMM under its logged IO events, the scope starts, the agent stages the same operations as play, and verify pairs each fire under its trigger key with the binding multiplicity. A fire with no free recorded occurrence stages unpaired, with no error (decision 36). The commit then makes the observer calls of play in the same order under sub_order(parent, i). An operation that stores, parks, or fires paired writes the hot store, and a paired fire removes its bindings. At an unpaired fire the commit fails after the COMM call with ReplayDivergence, or with the error of a rejected call as in play, and the operations before it stay applied. The sweep runs at the same point as in play, check_replay_data finds no unused binding, and the checkpoint gives the same root.](diagrams/07-checkpoint-replay-sweep.svg)
